Ashley (CS): Heads up — HeliosPay reports a markdown/stop-seq regression after today's canary. Code fences are not closing and we see extra trailing tokens appended to customer invoices. They say it started immediately after the canary push.

Priya (Support): Pasting the repro we ran against the hosted API (customer shared):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-quant","prompt":"```python\nprint(\"invoice\")\n```\n","stop":["```"],"max_tokens":40}'
```
Response (trimmed):
```
{
  "id": "r_abc",
  "output": "```python\nprint(\"invoice\")\n```EXTRA-TOKENS\n"
}
```
They expected the stop token to truncate at the closing fence but instead the fence is followed by literal text `EXTRA-TOKENS`.

Sam (Eng): Which model variant and canary id? Any deploy metadata?

Ashley (CS): Canary was promoted this morning (canary id 2004992000 -> traffic 80%). Model variant: redwood-v2-quant (commit abc1234). Customer repro against hosted endpoint.

Miguel (SRE): Any 5xx/latency spikes around rollout? Also curious if generator returned completed=true or still streamed after stop.

Priya (Support): No 5xx from customer side, 200 OK. They did see slightly higher tail latency (~150ms) but not huge. In their response the model marked finish_reason=null and tokens kept streaming past the stop. Customer says they rely on exact fences for downstream parsers, so this breaks parsing.

Sam (Eng): This smells like a postprocessing/decoder filter regression—stop-seq check probably got reordered. I can reproduce locally with the supplied payload. Quick local run shows closing fence followed by a few garbage tokens. Repro steps saved to INF tracker.

deploy-bot: Deploy canary 2004992000 -> 80% traffic completed :white_check_mark:

Ashley (CS): Customer asked for a short-term workaround. Suggested switching to redwood-v2-stable or pinning to redwood-v1-stable; they can accept that while we fix.

Sam (Eng): Will open INF-4721 with logs + exact tokenizer debug. Tentative hotfix plan: rollback canary to previous decoder path or patch stop-seq postfilter. I'll post ETA in the ticket.

Priya (Support): I'll escalate to the account and propose the temporary model pin. Also sending the raw responses to Sam. Customer is awaiting, they mentioned invoices are failing parsing which is blocking settlement. :disappointed_relieved:

Ashley (CS): Thanks. Keep the channel updated with the fix/rollback status. If we confirm it's commit abc1234, schedule immediate rollback.

Sam (Eng): Understood — will update INF-4721 and ping here once rollback/hotfix is done.

Miguel (SRE): I'll keep an eye on telemetry for any correlated anomalies and watch for any other customers hitting similar patterns.

Ashley (CS): Appreciate it.
